result.summary: Overall layout is clean with only minor inconsistencies found; one notable issue is inconsistent favorite icon styling and slight content cropping in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon background differs between cards - white circle on the ramen bar image versus a dark semi-transparent circle on the pizza image below it
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button style (background color/opacity) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card title text is cut off at the edge of the screen in the 'Fastest near you' carousel
issues.suggestion: This is expected behavior for a horizontally scrollable carousel, but ensure the full title is accessible via scrolling or tooltip
